claims.claim: GradMax grows a network without disturbing learned behavior.
GradMax initializes new weights to maximize useful gradients through an SVD-based procedure.
The paper reports improved training dynamics across several vision settings.

summary: GradMax is a method for growing neural networks during training by adding neurons without disturbing learned behavior, initializing new weights via an SVD-based procedure to maximize useful gradients, and reports improved training dynamics in vision tasks.
